system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; prompt mechanism not described beyond a fixed reasoning prompt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Entities and relations within the knowledge graph are embedded into a continuous vec- tor space using SBERT
env_context_strategy.note: Retrieval is invoked by the agent's SEARCH action (agent-driven), but the retrieval itself is embedding-based over the TKG. No repository was in the evidence.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no config or run loop available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: When a S EARCH action is executed, the resulting retrieved facts (observation) are integrated into the agent’s memory
observation_format.evidence_locator: paper Methodology, Reasoning and Answer Generation

tool_call_format.note: Actions SEARCH/FINISH are parsed from the model output (PARSE(Action)), but the syntax is not described.

tool_count.evidence_quote: either performing a S EARCH —by formulating a sub-query with explicit temporal constraints to retrieve relevant facts from the temporal knowledge graph—or initiating a F INISH op- eration
tool_count.evidence_locator: paper Methodology, Reasoning and Answer Generation
tool_count.note: The two actions are SEARCH and FINISH.

edit_primitive.note: No code was available. Editing is not part of the TKGQA task.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
The reasoning agent operates within an iterative loop,
limited to a maximum of N attempts.
loop_primitives.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Iterative Answer Verification / Methods
loop_primitives.note: Iterative generate -> LLM validation -> retry; paper-only description.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The agent maintains an internal dialogue memory composed of thought–action–observation triples.
planning_granularity.evidence_locator: paper Methodology, Reasoning and Answer Generation

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: SAR models TKGQA as an interactive pro- cess involving two key components: a reasoning agent and a validation module.
multi_agent_topology.note: The validator is an LLM critic prompt, not a separate agent.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the valida- tion module—implemented as an LLM prompt acting as a critic—evaluates the candidate’s correctness.
self_verification.note: The paper does not state whether the critic is the same model; it may be closer to self_critique.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: This iterative process continues until a valid response is confirmed or a predefined maximum ofN attempts is reached
retry_policy.note: The run repeats until the verifier passes, capped at N=2 by default. fixed_n is also a plausible coding.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: This iterative ReAct reasoning cycle continues, pro- gressively refining the agent’s internal understanding and aligning closely with factual evidence, until a FINISH action is triggered.
termination_condition.evidence_locator: paper Methodology, Reasoning and Answer Generation
termination_condition.note: The run also ends on a VALID verdict from the verifier or when the cap of N attempts is reached. test_pass is used here as the closest value for the verifier verdict.

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on MultiTQ and CronQuestions, but the repository was not available to confirm an evaluation runner.

target_domain.evidence_quote: TKGQA is the task of answering questions using facts stored in TKGs

open_source.note: The paper links a repository, but no license was in the evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we evaluate SAR across multiple backbones, including OpenAI’s GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4.1, as well as the open- source, 70B-parameter Llama3-Instruct.

primary_artifact.note: The repository contents were not provided, so coding is from the paper (AAAI-26).
